businesses.business: pool equipment and industrial flow control

offering_description.value: Hayward designs and manufactures equipment for residential and commercial swimming pools, including pumps, filters, heaters, sanitation systems and automated controls. It also makes thermoplastic valves and other flow-control equipment for industrial customers. It sells primarily through specialty distributors, dealers and retailers.

primary_products.value: pool pumps and filters; pool heaters; pool sanitation systems; pool controls and lighting; industrial thermoplastic valves and strainers

customer_segment.value: B2B: pool distributors, builders, service companies, commercial pool operators, and industrial system integrators; B2C: homeowners buying pool equipment through dealers and retailers

end_markets.value: residential swimming pools; commercial aquatics and hospitality; industrial water treatment; chemical processing

revenue_model.value: product sales: new and replacement pool equipment, spare parts, and industrial flow-control equipment

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: uses plastics and mechanical and electronic components to make equipment sold to pool and industrial distributors

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Europe, Australia and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: residential and commercial pool equipment and industrial thermoplastic flow-control equipment

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: specialty pool distributors, independent pool dealers and industrial equipment distributors; third-party retail: specialty pool supply stores; online: third-party pool equipment e-commerce retailers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: U.S. Department of Energy efficiency rules for pool pumps and product electrical safety standards
